'**Stealth** / When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck. / Whenever this banishes an attack action card, gain 1{h}.' Assassin Action - Attack.

STEALTH NOT AUTHORED: it is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field - authoring it again would be a defect.

HIT TRIGGER: TRIGGERED + ON_HIT + ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO is the shipped shape for an Action - Attack's own 'When this hits' clause; ON_HIT maps to the engine event (trigger_types.py:6). ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO (condition_types.py:1960-1977) is false when the attack was declared at an ally or permanent - exactly release note 2 ('does not trigger if you hit anything other than a hero').

BANISH THE TOP CARD: LOOK_AT (zone DECK_TOP, player OPPONENT, amount 1) peeks WITHOUT moving and stores the single card unwrapped under ref 'top' (effect_types.py:3356-3415); BANISH_REF then banishes it through the canonical banish keyword. from_zone 'deck' is REQUIRED: without an origin zone banish() leaves the card in place while also adding it to the banished zone - present in both zones at once (effect_types.py:3726-3752). face_down defaults to False, so the card is banished face-up into the owner's banished zone per release note 1. Empty deck: LOOK_AT stores None, BANISH_REF no-ops on a falsy ref, and the CONDITIONAL's when fails - no gain, no crash.

'WHENEVER THIS BANISHES' MODELED INLINE: there is no ON_BANISH trigger dispatched to the banishing card, so the gain rides as a CONDITIONAL in the same ability execution, immediately after BANISH_REF, testing the just-banished ref with REF_IS_TYPE types ['Attack'] (the matcher unions the card's types AND subtypes, condition_types.py:2011-2043; subtype Attack is carried by attack action cards only, so one node suffices - adding 'Action' to the list would wrongly match non-attack actions under the ANY-match). This placement makes release note 3 hold BY CONSTRUCTION: a banish from resolving a DIFFERENT card's effect never runs this ability's effect list, so it can never pay the 1{h}. GAIN asset LIFE_POINTS routes to effect_gain_life (effect_types.py:4890-4896).

BOUNDED OVER-MATCH, flagged not fixed: if a replacement effect ever prevented the banish itself, the inline test would still read the ref and could pay the 1{h} - the printed text does not separately address that corner, and inventing machinery for it is out of scope for a draft.

Same shape as the sibling printings desires_of_flesh_yellow/blue already in .drafts/.
